test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical/spelling error. According to Mr. Sharma / the news have come / as another blow / to the family members.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noun "**news**" is an uncountable noun and is treated as singular in English grammar.
 
• Therefore, it should be followed by a singular verb, not a plural one.
 
• The phrase "**the news have come**" is incorrect. The correct form is "**the news has come**."
 
• This error lies in subject-verb agreement, where a singular subject must take a singular verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"According to Mr. Sharma, the news **has come** as another blow to the family members."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "as another blow"** – Grammatically and contextually correct.
 
• **Option 3: "According to Mr. Sharma"** – Correct reporting phrase.
 
• **Option 4: "to the family members"** – Correct prepositional phrase indicating the impact.
